site_description: Sleep, food and light for people who work overnights. A free planner, five long guides, one book — written by someone who has done the shifts.
lede: Enter your shift times, get the schedule. Everything here is original, cited and free to read; the planner needs no sign-up and uploads nothing.
author: J. Arek Thorne

notes.base_url: Leave empty until a domain exists. Empty means no canonical tags and no sitemap.xml — the builder prefers omitting those to inventing a host. Set it after the site is live, then run ./wf site to rebuild.
notes.affiliate_hosts: Any link whose host matches one of these gets rel="sponsored nofollow" and a disclosure banner at the top of the page. FTC requires the disclosure; the builder makes it impossible to forget.
notes.no_build_step: GitHub Pages and Netlify Drop both serve the generated docs/ folder as-is, which is why there is no bundler here.
notes.contact: How readers reach you — an address, a form URL, anything real. The footer prints it only when it is non-empty; leaving it empty is honest, inventing an inbox is not. Fill this before applying to any affiliate programme.
